description: Edits and simulates combinational logic circuits.

methods.name: addEdge(source: string, target: string, type = TP_LOGIC_WIRE, sourcePort?: TpGraphPort, targetPort?: TpGraphPort, direction: TpGraphEdgeDirection = "forward"): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Connects compatible logic nodes with a forward wire and returns its record. Validates input capacity and resolves the target input port; invalid connections throw.

methods.name: addNode(type: string, point: TpGraphPoint, label?: string): TpGraphNode
methods.description: Adds a supported logic gate, input, output or comment at graph coordinates point with the optional label; returns a detached node record. Unsupported types throw TypeError.

methods.name: evaluate(): void
methods.description: Recomputes combinational logic, replaces the displayed graph and emits tp-logic-evaluate.

methods.name: reconnectEdge(edgeId: string, endpoint: "source" | "target", nodeId: string, port: TpGraphPort): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Reconnects an existing wire endpoint after checking logic compatibility and available input capacity; returns the updated edge record.

methods.name: setGraph(graph: TpGraphDocument): void
methods.description: Validates the specialized graph before replacing the editor graph; retains the base editor cloning and undo-history behavior. Invalid data throws without replacing the graph.

methods.name: toggle(id: string, propagate = true): boolean
methods.description: Inverts the Boolean state of input or output id and returns the new value. Input changes propagate through the circuit unless propagate is false; other node types throw.

methods.name: toggleEquationNotation(): TpLogicalEquationNotation
methods.description: Switches equations between electronic and mathematical notation, redraws results and returns the selected notation.

methods.name: toggleRepresentation(): TpLogicGateRepresentation
methods.description: Switches gate symbols between iso and ansi, redraws the circuit and returns the selected representation.

events.name: tp-logic-evaluate
events.description: Emitted after combinational outputs are recomputed; graph contains the resulting snapshot.

events.name: tp-logic-toggle
events.description: Emitted after an input node is toggled; id identifies the input, value is its new Boolean level, and graph contains the resulting snapshot.
events.detail: { id: string; value: boolean; graph: TpGraphDocument }

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-graph-logical-circuit>` element implements the <tp-icon name="graph-logical-circuit" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Logical circuit functionality: edits and simulates combinational logic circuits.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Click | Click an input to toggle it and immediately propagate the new signal through the circuit. |
| Using the component | Inputs, outputs, and gates use `success` when their value is `true` and `danger` when it is `false`. |
| Using the component | Outputs can also be clicked to inspect or override their displayed state; the next evaluation restores the value computed from their incoming wire. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Toggles the focused input or output terminal. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |

keyboard.description: Toggles the focused input or output terminal.
